profile.name: VISA通信器
profile.description: 非物理软件通信组件，将 VISA/pyVISA 连接封装为类文件对象，用于在实验系统中按资源名访问兼容 VISA 的仪器会话，并管理原始字节读写、终止符、超时和输入缓冲区。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software communication component that exposes a VISA/pyVISA connection as a file-like object for laboratory systems. It is used to access VISA-compatible instrument sessions by resource name and manage raw byte I/O, termination settings, timeouts, and input-buffer handling.

registry.name: VISA Instrument Communicator
registry.description: VISA Instrument Communicator是由IVI Foundation生产的实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括关闭、写入数据、读取数据。支持Signal, Slot, address等操作。
